student_friendly_summary: Directly compare, describe, and order common objects using length, height, width, or weight; describe differences.
Classify and sort up to ten objects by an attribute; count objects in each category and order categories by count.
Ask and answer questions using gathered information, observations, and appropriate graphical displays for everyday problems.
Determine whether a group of up to 20 objects has an odd or even count; express an even number as two equal addends.
Use addition to determine the total in rectangular arrays of up to five rows and columns; write an equal-addends equation.
Describe, compare, and sort two- and three-dimensional shapes by their attributes.
Identify at least one line of symmetry in everyday objects.
Partition circles and rectangles into two, three, or four equal shares and name the fractional parts.
Recognize that equal shares of identical wholes may have different shapes.
Explain a fraction as division of the numerator by the denominator.
